tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise backend services and e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs and microservices for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record designing web and mobile-facing headless APIs, executing data and system integrations, and leading database query optimization. Experienced with CI/CD deployment cycles, cloud environments, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile collaboration.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of backend engineering experience designing robust Java services, scalable REST APIs, and enterprise integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer position. Your focus on building high-performance services across modern web and mobile ecosystems aligns directly with my architectural background.

bullets.label: Java & Microservices Architecture
bullets.text: Engineered core backend functionality using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, applying strict design patterns, data modeling, and JUnit testing to support high-throughput enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Web & Mobile API Ecosystems
bullets.text: Developed headless OCC REST web services and RESTful APIs powering responsive storefronts, PWA applications, and cross-channel consumers with tailored Interceptors and Converters.

bullets.label: Performance & Data Integration
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring to reduce latency and improve transaction performance, while designing stable data pipelines connecting ERP, PIM, and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed technical code reviews, provided mentoring to junior developers, and resolved complex production integration bottlenecks.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit (no sponsorship required), currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026, and available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and integration experience can support your engineering initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: Your commitment to engineering scalable backend systems across expansive web and mobile ecosystems offers the ideal environment for my expertise. Having spent over five years designing resilient Java and Spring APIs for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute high-performance architecture and proven integration leadership to your platform.
tailoring.motivation_short: Senior Java Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience delivering robust Spring microservices, headless REST APIs, and database performance tuning for large-scale enterprise platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I noticed your opening for a Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer. With 5+ years of Java/Spring backend delivery, headless API design for web/mobile ecosystems, and enterprise integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would welcome the chance to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior / Lead Backend Java Engineer position. With more than 5 years of professional experience developing robust Java and Spring backend services, scalable REST APIs, and data integrations for enterprise platforms, I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my technical background aligns with your team's goals.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
